status.comment: B2 2026-07-24: template in force since Phase A (campaign writes cards from it); fact grain from birth

facts.CARD-ONE-PROMISE: One card = one promise worth telling a reader about.
facts.CARD-WRITTEN-HOT: Written in the minute the knowledge is hot (verification or fix just done); polished later, in the documentation stage — never now.

facts.FIELD-PROMISE: **Promise (reader's register, one sentence):** what the reader can do, not what the system must. E.g. "You can pin a dependency to a local checkout with one manifest line."
facts.FIELD-PROVEN-EXAMPLE: **Proven example:** command + real output, captured from the verification run (this is the doc fixture — it was actually executed):

facts.FIELD-GOTCHAS: **Gotchas / edge cases:** what surprised us; what the reader will trip on.
facts.FIELD-STABILITY: **Stability:** freeze-candidate | still-moving (`still-moving` cards wait; a chapter is written only from stable cards).
